summary: Reproduced the is_musa import-induced TorchDynamo gb0069 failure with the real SGLang probe under both cold and warm lru_cache states. The candidate resolves the complete MUSA detection fact at module import, retains the cached public API, and passes cold/warm fullgraph traces. A real ROCm Inductor kernel using is_musa ran numerically correctly on one MI350X and produced gfx950 AMDGCN/HSACO artifacts.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the change, both cold and pre-warmed calls to the actual sglang.srt.utils.common.is_musa failed fullgraph compilation with Unsupported: Import failure, module_name: torchada, gb0069. The script handled the expected exceptions and therefore exited zero. See reproduction-before.txt.
The preserved regression passed for cold and warm is_musa cache states with torch.compile(backend=eager, fullgraph=True): 1 test and 2 subtests passed.
Related common utility, context-parallel strategy, and platform prefill-CP tests: 37 tests and 57 subtests passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-cb4d66c638af/torchinductor-gpu XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-cb4d66c638af/cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-cb4d66c638af/venv/bin/python < ROCm fullgraph Inductor numerical control
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, a fullgraph Inductor kernel calling is_musa matched an independent NumPy float32 reference (max absolute error 2.384185791015625e-07; allclose rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-6). Triton emitted triton_poi_fused_add_mul_pow_sin_0.hsaco and AMDGCN assembly targeted at amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx950. See rocm-control.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, torch.version.hip 7.2.26015, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. The generated ELF was elf64-amdgpu with EF_AMDGPU_MACH_AMDGCN_GFX950 and amdhsa.target amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx950.

remaining_limitations: The original 8-GPU NVIDIA B200 MiniMax-M3 tc_piecewise prefill CUDA-graph deployment was not available and was not run; this one-GPU ROCm control does not qualify that deployment.
No MUSA hardware or torchada installation was available. The implementation preserves the previous detection predicate: torchada must import and torch.version.musa must be non-null.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
Compiler caches and generated GPU artifacts remain under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-cb4d66c638af, outside the repository checkout.
